title: Hunter x Hunter (2011)
hook: How does Hunter x Hunter (2011) end? The fall of Meruem, Gon's terrible victory, and his reunion with Ging, explained in full.

sections.heading: The end of the Chimera Ant King
sections.body: The series climax belongs to the Chimera Ant arc. Chairman Netero detonates the Poor Man's Rose, a miniature nuclear bomb sealed in his own body, sacrificing himself to wound the King, Meruem. Meruem survives but is left dying from the radioactive poison. In his final hours he chooses to spend them beside Komugi, the blind gungi prodigy who taught him the worth of a single human life. The two play their last game as the poison takes them, and Meruem dies holding Komugi's hand, the conqueror undone not by force but by the connection he never expected to feel.

sections.heading: Gon's terrible victory
sections.body: Parallel to the King's fall, Gon confronts Neferpitou over the death of his mentor Kite. Consumed by rage and grief, Gon makes a self destroying vow that ages him into an adult form of monstrous power, sacrificing his entire future as a Hunter to obliterate Pitou. He wins, but the cost leaves him comatose and dying, his body burned out by the transformation. It is the darkest beat of the series, the moment Gon's stubborn love curdles into something terrifying, and it nearly kills him alongside the enemy he destroys.

sections.heading: Killua, Alluka, and the wish that saves Gon
sections.body: During the Election arc that follows, Killua refuses to let Gon die. He brings his sister Alluka, who hosts the wish granting entity Nanika, and makes the dangerous request to heal Gon completely. Nanika restores Gon's broken body and his lost potential, pulling him back from death. The bond between the two boys, which carried the whole series, pays off here. Killua then decides to devote himself to protecting Alluka, and he and Gon, healed and reunited, recognize that their paths are about to diverge after everything they survived together.

sections.heading: Gon meets his father at the World Tree
sections.body: The thematic payoff is the reunion that drove Gon from the start. He climbs to the top of the colossal World Tree, where his father Ging is waiting. The two finally talk as equals, Gon recounting his adventures and Ging musing about exploring the unknown world beyond mankind's maps. Gon and Killua part to chase their own futures, their friendship intact even as they separate. The anime closes its prologue here, returning Gon to a quieter wonder, watching rare swans with Kite and his friends, the long chase for his father complete.

final_image: Gon takes in a breathtaking view of small-billed swans alongside Kite and his friends, the frantic journey behind him and a calmer horizon ahead.

lingering_questions.q: Does Gon lose his Nen at the end of Hunter x Hunter 2011?
lingering_questions.a: He nearly loses everything. Gon's vow against Pitou burns out his body and ability, leaving him comatose. Killua uses Alluka's power Nanika to fully heal him, restoring his body and his potential as a Hunter.

lingering_questions.q: Do Gon and Killua stay together at the end?
lingering_questions.a: No. After Gon is healed they choose to part ways, Killua to protect his sister Alluka and Gon to reunite with his father Ging. Their friendship remains intact even as their paths separate.
